rounds: I would give up flying for five years if everyone else did too.
Eating less meat is a bigger sacrifice than giving up a car.
People who live a green life deserve some kind of reward.
Young people shouldn’t have to pay for the emissions of older generations.
I wouldn’t mind the government knowing exactly how much energy I use.
Banning private jets would do more good than any climate app.
If a climate policy works, it doesn’t matter how unpopular it is.
In twenty years, flying somewhere for a weekend will seem as strange as smoking on planes.
